all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The Canadian government proposed a programme for making assistance grants to support employment and mitigate the effects of US import taxes on certain industries.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: The programme aims to support employment, which can enhance productivity and economic stability.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The programme has been put into action to support affected industries.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The programme is significant as it addresses employment impacts from external economic pressures.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: To support employment in Canada by mitigating the disruptive effects on those industries particularly hard hit by the US surcharge, the Canadian government proposed on 7th September a programme for making assistance grants.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The description focuses on 'assistance grants to support employment' without a clear connection to R&D funding or knowledge transfer.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The introduction of a 10 percent tax credit on purchases of new machinery and equipment produced in the United States aims to incentivize investment in domestic production capabilities.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: The tax credit is designed to encourage investment in domestic production, which can lead to increased productivity and innovation.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The tax credit has been enacted and is currently in effect.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The tax credit represents a significant incentive for businesses to invest in new equipment.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: a 10 percent tax credit on purchases of new machinery and equipment produced in the United States;
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The reform describes a '10 percent tax credit on purchases of new machinery and equipment' which does not directly relate to R&D funding or innovation instruments for firms.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The Canadian government implemented a series of capital-incentive measures, including a loan fund of CJ 150 million to be distributed to provinces based on unemployment levels for job-creating capital projects, capital-incentive grants to stimulate investment in the private business sector, and a 10 percent tax credit on purchases of new machinery and equipment produced in the United States to incentivize domestic investment in capital goods.
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: These measures are designed to stimulate investment and job creation, which can enhance productivity and economic growth.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The measures have been put into effect as part of the government's economic strategy.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: The reforms represent significant but narrower changes aimed at stimulating investment in the economy.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: a special programme was launched to finance capital projects in regions of slower economic growth, and there was a further increase in transfer payments to provinces.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: The description emphasizes 'capital-incentive measures' and 'loan fund for job-creating capital projects', which are not focused on R&D funding or knowledge transfer.
